# AOSP avbtool

`avbtool.py` is unchanged AOSP source from `platform/external/avb` commit `761178607206f4cb2af79ed9eec52d8cbd814adb` (2025-03-13), version 1.3.0.

Source: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/external/avb/+/761178607206f4cb2af79ed9eec52d8cbd814adb/avbtool.py

SHA256: `e5a664a38db623da00f080219bc0ee60a640a9dc4a872803616fae4938ac749b`

Its MIT license and copyright notice remain in the source header. `Scripts/avbtool_windows.py` adapts RSA operations to the bundled cryptography library and uses closed temporary files for external signing helpers on Windows.
